verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a natural-language interface for operating Crossmint. Crossmint is presented as a set of REST APIs and SDKs for wallets, payments and agent cards. The nearest items do not qualify: ingesting the docs into AI code helpers and a docs query server are developer building blocks. Agent Checkouts letting a user "steer" a checkout run is a related feature, driven by a product URL and spending cap rather than natural-language commands to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
